anti_stall_policy: DeliveryOS must be sidecar/fail-open relative to native order intake and native fiscal operation.
Unknown routing/packaging blocks only the corresponding automated effect, never the native order.
Ambiguous print/fiscal effects receive reconciliation, not blind retry.
Stable identity + dedupe precedes every effect.
Native fiscal state is observed before any retry or reprint decision.
